provenance: Synthetic educational examples; not author data or a replication of Duncan et al. 2019.

ld.assumption: All three SNP are within the same clumping window; AC and BC r_squared are zero; SNP A has the smallest association p-value.

r_squared.kind: Ordinary SSE/SST R_squared for a continuous toy phenotype, not an exact definition of all source studies' reported explained variance.

t_test.kind: One-sample t-test on independent fictional ratios of one common metric; not reconstruction of authors' input vector.

confounding.kind: Simplified adjustment by group indicator, not computed genetic PCs. Phenotype constructed to depend only on group/environment in this example.

aggregate_correlation.kind: Three fictional population aggregates, synthetic weights; illustrates change of score/correlation, not a causal explanation for real GWAS differences.

original_normalization_example.provenance: Actual example reported in Duncan et al. Methods Part 1 (Purcell 2009 schizophrenia comparison).
